== English errata comparison sources ==
The Limited face permits any asteroid sector and names the opponent’s control phases. The November 1998 glossary requires a sector you control and uses your control phases. It also describes Decipher’s exchange of earlier copies. Both checked errata faces match the glossary. The physical Revised face adds “Once during” and remains in Versions as a separate printing.
